source.title: Margin Call (2011), boardroom scene

action_items.text: Call the traders in for their 6:30am meeting and be honest with them about the sell-off.
action_items.quote: you call the traders in for their normal 6:30am meeting and you be honest with them

action_items.text: Have forty percent of the positions sold by 10:15.

action_items.quote: By 11:00 all your trades have to be gone

decisions.text: Sell the firm's positions today to willing buyers at the current market price, to survive.
decisions.quote: We are selling to willing buyers at the current fair market price -- so that we may survive.

notes: The action items are the plan one participant lays out and the closing decision adopts; no owner is assigned to any of them. Whether a prescribed plan counts as an action item is a judgment call.
